description: A pink Art Deco club at night with glowing neon stripes and a neon flamingo sign. A smiling doorman in a black suit unhooks a red velvet rope from its brass post and holds it aside to let a guest in. A young woman with curly hair, in a white satin top and skirt and strappy heels, walks past him up the speckled terrazzo steps towards the entrance, glancing back happily. Warm light spills from inside, palm trees stand by the pavement and a few people wait further down the street.
